ChangedDecoders: PDF417 uses known missing codeword positions for bounded prime-field erasure correction; mixed damage must satisfy 2*unknownErrors+erasures<=parity. Corrected codeword vectors pass final syndrome verification.
Qualified pixel rows decode directly, retaining readable prefixes from damaged tails. Fully framed observations outrank partial observations; partial rows cannot establish an assembly header.
Ordinary decoding runs across all slopes before erasure recovery. Each orientation retains at most 128 immutable recovery candidates, ordered by fewer erasures.
Correction and recovery loops check cancellation and the existing monotonic deadline. Public APIs and production dependencies are unchanged.
AttributionLimits: This follow-up records 187/267 correct positive images versus 184/267 in the previous pass. No previous positive successes are lost in this run. Paired negative passes complete 29-31/31 with the current binary and 30-31/31 with the previous binary. The supplementary negative pass completes 24/25 versus 25/25 previously; falsepositives-2/01.png is now inconclusive. The two PDF417 gains have damaged-image regression proof. The additional qrcode-3/11.png success previously exceeded its deadline; QR decoding is unchanged, so that result is not attributed to the PDF417 repair. Every pass and initial overall/per-domain CPU reading is retained. Shared-host load and wall-clock deadlines limit attribution; no general timeout guarantee is established. PDF417 generated damaged-row regressions are separate from the unchanged frozen corpus. Erasure correction requires qualified row assembly and enough readable framing; arbitrary occlusion or perspective is not established. The long AI (3922) oracle in rssexpandedstacked-2/13.png exceeds the GS1 field limit; raw encoded digits are returned, but the invalid parenthesized oracle remains verbatim and remains failed under unchanged scoring. One Expanded Stacked image result per request is supported; arbitrary perspective and multiple-symbol localization are not established.

RegressionProof.Coverage: Six generated missing-row/damaged-tail image cases, three unmodified independent damaged/skewed fixtures, 144 seeded error/erasure vectors across all nine correction levels, malformed/excessive damage and cancellation. Exact payload/codeword arrays and unchanged image inputs are asserted.
